Purpose¶

This interactive app has been built to help people understanding, and somehow gathering insights, whether a train could be canceled, delayed, and if delayed, how much delay the customer would likely has to face.

We picked two use-case, that framed our entire application :

one could want to overview the global railway network punctuality informations (mean delay at arrival route by route, and possible delay causes), one could want to setup a specific trip, with a given pair departure - destination, on a particular time frame over the year (monthly is the best available sampling).
